  1. Must see · Yogyakarta

    Borobudur

    The world's largest Buddhist temple, a 9th-century stupa-mountain of 2,600+ relief panels — UNESCO World Heritage.

    Look for UNESCO Buddhist temple

    Magelang Regency (near Yogyakarta), Central Java, Indonesia

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

  2. Must see · Yogyakarta

    Prambanan

    Indonesia's largest Hindu temple compound, a soaring 9th-century Shiva complex — UNESCO World Heritage.

    Look for UNESCO Hindu temple

    Sleman (Yogyakarta–Central Java border), Indonesia

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia
